content.title: 将来进行时 will be doing 速查
content.intro: 将来进行时 = will be + doing。核心含义:① 将来某一时刻"正在进行"的动作;② 委婉客观地询问对方安排;③ 顺理成章、按计划会发生的将来。判断口诀:看到 this time tomorrow / at 8 tonight / while you are… 等"将来某点或同时"标志,就用 will be doing。

rows: this time tomorrow / at 8 tonight:I will be taking my exam this time tomorrow.
while you are…:While you are sleeping, I will be travelling to work.
Will you be doing…?:Will you be using the car tonight?
…anyway / as usual:I will be seeing him tomorrow anyway.

specialRules.rule: 结构固定:will be + 现在分词(doing),be 不能省
强调那一刻"正进行/持续"用 will be doing;表"一次性完成/承诺/决定"用 will do
specialRules.mark: At 8 I will be having dinner(进行)/ I will pay you back(承诺)

specialRules.rule: Will you be doing…? 比 Will you do…? 更客观礼貌,不带请求或施压
specialRules.mark: Will you be using it?(询问)/ Will you use it?(像请求)

specialRules.rule: 状态动词(know/like/be 等)一般不用进行时
specialRules.mark: I will know √ / I will be knowing ×

why: 将来进行时把镜头对准"将来的某一刻",描述那一刻正在持续的画面;所以它常和精确的将来时间点或另一个同时发生的动作搭配,而一般将来时只是笼统地说"将会做"。
gaokaoPoints: will be doing 与 will do 的辨析(进行/背景 vs 整体/完成):看有没有 this time tomorrow、at + 钟点、while 等标志。
Will you be doing…? 作委婉询问;I'll be doing… 表顺理成章的将来,是语法填空与语境选择高频考点。

examVsReal.exam: This time tomorrow I will be flying to London.(考试)
examVsReal.real: This time tomorrow I'll be flying to London.
examVsReal.note: 口语里 will 常缩写成 'll,意思不变

examVsReal.exam: Will you be using the computer this evening?(考试·委婉)
examVsReal.real: Are you going to use the computer tonight? / You using the computer later?
examVsReal.note: 日常口语也常用 be going to 或更随意的说法表达同样的询问
